messages:
Ana Lopez: Quick design thread: should the trace permalink live as a persistent icon on each drilldown row or be an action inside the row overflow? Mock: https://figma.com/file/trace-permalink-props
Derek White: Persistent icon is faster for power users. But it adds visual clutter in dense lists. Overflow keeps UI clean for first-time users.
Sasha Ivanov: What about hybrid: persistent, but hide on collapse or with a density toggle. Also we could show a lighter ghost icon until hover.
Mina Patel: Accessibility concern: icons alone are ambiguous. If we keep a persistent icon, it must be a real button with aria-label like \"Open permalink for trace 0xabc\" and focusable.
accessibility-bot: Contrast check: ghost icon on light theme must meet 3:1 against surface when interactive. Also ensure target size >= 44px touch for mobile.
Ana Lopez: Good call. Interaction question: should clicking the permalink copy link to clipboard or open a new tab? Currently designers prefer a copy affordance with a confirmation toast. Thoughts?
Derek White: Copy is safer for many workflows (paste into ticket). But power users also want open-in-new-tab. Could do click=copy, alt-click/open icon opens new tab, and overflow menu has both options.
Sasha Ivanov: If click copies, we need clear microcopy: tooltip on hover \"Copy trace link\" and toast \"Trace link copied\". Also allow keyboard: Enter to open menu, Space to copy? Need to define consistent semantics.
Mina Patel: Keyboard action: focused permalink -> Enter opens small action menu (Copy, Open, Export CSV, Export JSON). Space could activate primary action (copy). Document in keyboard help.
accessibility-bot: ARIA suggestion: use role=\"button\" for the icon and set aria-haspopup=\"menu\" when a keyboard menu is available; add aria-expanded when open. Use aria-live region for copy confirmations.
Ana Lopez: Export UX debate: CSV vs JSON. CSV is useful for bulk analysis of top frames, but JSON preserves full structure. Should we default to CSV for \"Export frames\" and JSON for \"Export trace\"?
Derek White: I like that default. CSV columns proposal: trace_id, timestamp, frame_index, function, file_path, line, severity, message. Keep path condensed for readability.
Sasha Ivanov: For CSV, include a header row and ensure commas in messages are escaped or quoted. Provide option in modal: \"Include full file paths\" checkbox.
Mina Patel: Filename scheme: trace-<traceid>-frames-2026-03-23.csv for CSV, trace-<traceid>-2026-03-23.json for JSON. Small copy note in modal: \"Exports respect current filters and visible frames.\"
accessibility-bot: Export dialog accessibility: set role=\"dialog\", trap focus, provide close button with aria-label \"Close export dialog\" and announce when download starts via aria-live.
Ana Lopez: Analytics: track which export type users choose, and whether they open vs copy permalink. Helps decide default.
Derek White: Implementation detail: when copying permalink include URL params that capture current filter and frame selection (e.g., ?frame=3&filters=errortype). But watch URL length; if too long, create a short-id server-side and copy short link.
Sasha Ivanov: For mobile web, copy is awkward; fall back to open-in-new-tab when clipboard API not available and show a toast explaining the action.
Mina Patel: Edge case: if a user copies link and then immediately clicks another copy, debounce toast so we don't spam. Show inline check icon for 1s on the specific icon clicked.
accessibility-bot: Live announcement example for copy: \"Trace link copied to clipboard. Open in a new tab: Shift+Click.\" Make sure this text is localizable.
Ana Lopez: I'll update the Figma with the persistent icon variant + ghost style and the overflow menu flow. @Mina will draft keyboard spec and menu ARIA attributes. @Derek will prototype server-side short-link fallback. @Sasha will draft CSV header examples and modal copy.
Sasha Ivanov: CSV header example:
```csv
trace_id,timestamp,frame_index,function,file_path,line,severity,message
0xabc,2026-03-23T14:12:01Z,3,handleRequest,src/service/api.js,128,ERROR,\"TypeError: x is undefined\"
```
Mina Patel: I'll also document focus order: row -> permalink -> overflow -> next row action. Post prototype updates here.
Ana Lopez: Thanks all :rocket: Will post updated file by EOD.
